requirements.evidence: All contract items are present: entities migration with `entities_slug_unique` (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entities_table.php:9-16`), `entity_memberships` with cascade FKs, role default and the `owner_seq` generated column plus `entity_memberships_one_owner` (`2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:10-23`), enum `manageable()` (`app/Models/UserRole.php:16-19`), models/relations (`app/Models/Entity.php:17-52`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:24-73`, `app/Models/User.php:35-56`), both policies (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:9-47`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:10-39`), the four routes including `entity.pick` with audit log and session write (`routes/web.php:54-75`), owner-only settings link (`resources/views/livewire/entity/dashboard.blade.php:10-14`) and exact pt_BR/en strings (`lang/pt_BR/ui.php:50-62`, `lang/en/ui.php:50-62`). Edge cases only partly covered: `Settings::delete()` makes two separate writes without a transaction (`app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:64-71`) and the 'last manager' guard in `removeMember()` can never fire because the owner is rejected earlier and always counts (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:99-116`).

conventions.evidence: Several clear deviations: domain writes live in the components/route closure instead of `app/Actions/*` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:30-117`, `app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:40-104`, `routes/web.php:54-71`), while the conventions require one Action class per use case; validation uses ad-hoc rule arrays inside actions instead of the project's `#[Validate]` + `$this->validate()` pattern (`app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:21-25,46-49`, `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:21,36-38`); `entity.pick` authorizes with inline `membershipFor()` instead of the existing `EntityPolicy::view` gate (`routes/web.php:55-60` vs `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:16-19`); no `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` entry despite the docs-freshness rule. Positives: migrations have reversible `down()` and deliberate `$fillable` (`app/Models/Entity.php:19`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:18`), views reuse `x-form-field`/`x-button` and `{{ }}` escaping, and `docs/database-schema.md` was updated (`docs/database-schema.md:149-152`).

security.evidence: Every mutating public method re-resolves the record from the locked entity and authorizes server-side: `$this->authorize('update', $entity)` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:34`), `$this->authorize('assignRole', $membership)` (`:74`), `$this->authorize('delete', $membership)` (`:103`), and `manageSettings` on save/delete/transfer (`app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:44,62,78`). The entity is `#[Locked]` everywhere (`Members.php:18-19`, `Settings.php:18-19`, `Dashboard.php:21-22`) so it cannot be swapped by the client; `entity.pick` checks membership before touching the session (`routes/web.php:56-62`); all output is auto-escaped in Blade. Remaining gap: `mount()` is only run on the first request, so `render()` re-reads memberships/admins without re-checking the caller's membership on later property-update requests (`Members.php:106-120`, `Settings.php:106-120`), and `$targetMembershipId` is not validated for type/existence before use (handled by 403, `Settings.php:82-105`).

tests.evidence: The diff adds no test files at all: no `tests/Feature` or `tests/Unit` file appears in `change.diff`, so the migrations, models, policies, routes and the three Livewire components ship with zero coverage - none of the mandated happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call or tamper tests exist.

simplicity.evidence: Some duplication/dead code: `Entity::findOrFail($this->entity->id)` is repeated in every action and in `render()` (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:32,69,94,169`) while `Settings` uses a `currentEntity()` helper (`Settings.php:35-38`); `addMember()` re-queries the user and re-checks null after `exists:users,email` already guarantees it (`Members.php:36-46`); `removeMember()`'s `$isManager`/`managerCount` guard is unreachable because owner memberships abort at `Members.php:99-101` (`:105-116`); the owner lookup in `transfer()` duplicates what `manageSettings` already established (`Settings.php:80-90`). Otherwise the implementation is direct and reuses existing components/lang.

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods are short and single-purpose (e.g. `save()`, `delete()`, `transfer()` in `app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:40-104`); docblocks match the project's PHPDoc style (`Entity.php:35-51`, `EntityMembership.php:33-72`); no debug output or dead files. Minor: the two access styles for the same entity (re-fetch inline vs `currentEntity()`), the redundant `Log::channel('audit')?->info(...)` nullsafe on a non-null logger (`routes/web.php:64`), and unclassed plain `<button>` elements in the members list (`resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:15-17`).

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff belongs to the task: models, migrations, policies, factories, enum, three Livewire components and views, four routes, the two lang files and the required `docs/database-schema.md` update; no unrelated refactors, features or files, and the out-of-scope items (onboarding, switcher, middleware, navbar) are absent.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, contrary to the project's test-first rule, so migrations, policies, routes and every Livewire action (including unauthorized-call and tamper cases) are unverified.
Domain writes (add member, assign role, remove, save, delete, transfer) are implemented directly in the components instead of through `app/Actions/*` classes as the conventions require.

Public input properties (`$email`, `$name`, `$slug`, `$targetMembershipId`) lack `#[Validate]` attributes and are validated with inline rule arrays in the actions, which deviates from the project's stated Livewire validation pattern.

`entity.pick` is a route closure that authorizes via `$user->membershipFor(...)` instead of the `EntityPolicy::view` gate, duplicating and bypassing the policy-based authorization the conventions mandate.

`render()` re-reads memberships/admins with no authorization check, and Livewire does not re-run `mount()` on update requests, so a user removed from the entity could still receive the member list on later re-render requests.
`delete()` performs two writes (membership deletion then soft delete) outside a transaction, so a failure in between can leave an entity whose memberships were already destroyed.
The 'last manager' (owner/admin) guard can never trigger: owner memberships already abort at line 99-101, and the owner always keeps the manager count above one, so the count query is dead code.
The docs-freshness convention requires an entry under `[Unreleased]` for this change, and none was added even though `docs/database-schema.md` was updated.
`Log::channel('audit')?->info(...)` applies a nullsafe operator to a logger that is never null; a plain `->info(...)` is clearer.

The action buttons are plain `<button>` elements without Bulma classes, and they are rendered for every row (including the owner and for employees who will get 403), which is inconsistent with the rest of the views and the Bulma conventions.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model, the owner/admin policies, the entity pick route and the three Livewire management pages (dashboard, members, settings with ownership transfer), and it keeps the schema docs and both locales in sync. It cannot be approved as is: there are no tests anywhere in the diff, and domain writes, `#[Validate]` usage and policy-based authorization in `entity.pick` depart from the project conventions; the remaining findings are minor correctness/cleanup items.
